observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A snowy winter town in Akita, Japan, inside wooden shrines and community halls, as well as outdoor snow-covered streets.
observation.dancers: Men and boys dancing in groups of two or three during performances and rehearsals.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers perform facing an audience or in small groups on elevated wooden stages and in open hall spaces, and walk in single-file processions outdoors through snow.
observation.posture: Torsos held upright with knees deeply bent in wide stances, weight shifting dynamically side to side or bouncing on the balls of the feet.
observation.footwork: Stepping, lifting knees high in place, stamping, and quick pivoting turns synchronized to drumbeats.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held wide or raised overhead, holding folding fans with the red sun emblem, wooden sticks, or trailing feathered/shag adornments.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torsos remain relatively upright with slight lateral bends or forward inclinations accompanying knee bends and bounces.
observation.partnering: None; dancers perform individual or synchronized group movements without physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low stances with bent knees, hopping steps, and sharp pivots/turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Dark blue robes with white fan crest insignia, tall white/red hats, feathered/fringed sashes, white face paint with red accents, and handheld fans or wooden batons.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise foot-to-floor weight transfer and intricate micro-steps are occluded by wide camera angles and quick cuts.

signature_moments.what: Dancers in wide stances bouncing with bent knees while stamping rhythmically and holding props.
